blockers.details: No single official source found with a complete end-to-end one-row-per-day-stage Nordkalottleden inventory from Kautokeino to all southern variants.
Geometry QA artifacts now exist for all 12 sections, but sections 1, 2, 8, 11 and 12 still need explicit endpoint connector or endpoint-policy decisions before navigation-grade import.
Sections 1 and 2 still need Saarijarvi endpoint/spur policy because the selected current hut yard is about 152.3 m from the official route line.

Sections 11 and 12 still need Madam Bongos/Cunovuohppi endpoint policy because the legacy place coordinate is about 65.4 m from the Turrutebasen E1 route projection and should not be imported as active lodging.

Sections 7 and 8 need Saraelv/Ovi connector or compound-endpoint policy because the generated section 7 artifact ends at Saraelv while section 8 starts at Ovi Raishiin, leaving about a 1003.9 m inter-section continuity gap.
Official route variants around Abisko-Gautelis and Gappohytta-Rostahytta are not resolved.

openDecisions: Decide whether to normalize only the researched Reisa/Käsivarsi/Kautokeino 12-section candidate model before the whole-trail section model is resolved.
Decide endpoint/connector policy for Saarijärvi hut yard, Saraelv/Ovi Raishiin, Madam Bongos/Čunovuohppi and the section 6 source-boundary junction.
Decide how the app should represent a trail with multiple candidate section models and unresolved southern endpoint/variant logic.
Decide whether Madam Bongos/Čunovuohppi appears only as legacy endpoint/access metadata and never as active lodging.
Decide how much country-specific rule logic belongs in route-level warnings versus per-section warnings.
